title: Final equip/unequip fix, pet stay-at-destructible behavior, destructible poof effect and fade-in respawn
description: 1. Fix equip/unequip: ensure _isPetEquipped checks both local equipped list and the pet's own equipped boolean. Ensure UIController refreshes correctly after equip/unequip events. 2. Verify pet stay-at-destructible behavior in PetController (already correct). 3. Add destructible poof effect (3-4 particles in destructible color) on destroy. 4. Add fade-in animation on destructible respawn (Transparency 1->0 over 0.5s). 5. Ensure currency popup appears at destructible position (already correct).
steps: Fix UIController._isPetEquipped to work correctly with both string IDs and pet data objects
Ensure UIController refreshes pet grid after equip/unequip to reflect button state change
Add destructible destruction poof effect in EffectsController (3-4 colored particles)
Add fade-in animation for respawned destructibles in ZoneService
Ensure currency popup uses destructible position (verify existing code)
